Edge and crest shapes: Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2025 and 2026 (Copernicus Sentinel data and service information are free and open, Regulation (EU) No 1159/2013 and the Sentinel data legal notice). Outlines only: no pixel or image is in the repository or the app (D269).

method.code: scripts/reef/build-reefs.ts (the steps and why), scripts/reef/build-reef.ts traceScene (the home's trace, one body for every island), scripts/reef/trace.ts (the method and why), scripts/reef/scenes.ts, scripts/reef/osm-reefs.ts, scripts/reef/kulhi.ts, scripts/reef/transform.ts, scripts/reef/tiff.ts, scripts/reef/utm.ts, scripts/reef/encode-reefs.ts
method.reflectance: Sentinel-2 L2A DN / 10,000 (Element84 has removed the L2A offset)
method.land: B08 > B03 (NDWI < 0), held above every threshold
method.edge: the open sea's median + 6 robust sigma in B03 reflectance, on the window's 8-pixel frame
method.crest: Otsu (256 bins) on ln(smoothed B03) over the water inside the edge
method.smoothing: B03 blurred by a Gaussian of sigma 1 px before both contours; land set after
method.contour: marching squares at pixel centres; the largest loop round the island's centroid
method.simplification: Douglas–Peucker at 5 m true in the island's own frame, then quantised once to 1e-5 degrees

depth: Not traced: no open source gives these reefs' depth. The game draws a depth profile from the shore on these outlines, as it does at home (kaabafain src/scene/reef.ts; D283, D293), which is game tuning, not data derived from OpenStreetMap, Sentinel-2 or Landsat.

sentinel2.rule: no Sentinel-2 scene before 2020 holds a pixel over the island's window (re-checked from these files every build); the first Sentinel-2 images of the island are from June 2021, after the airport

method.water: MNDWI = (green − SWIR1) / (green + SWIR1) ≥ 0, TM bands 2 and 5, reflectance DN × 0.0000275 − 0.2
method.enclosed: water a 4-connected flood from the window's border does not reach
method.kept: the largest enclosed region whose centre is inside the charted outline, at least 3 pixels; every other enclosed region listed in dropped
method.outline: marching squares at MNDWI 0, other water held at −1; Douglas–Peucker at 15 m true; quantised to 1e-5 degrees
